about: A place outside a town's own section sends a blackout to the nearest Pokemon Center on the town map (savedit.place_spawn), whatever fly points the save has: route29-official.sav, which has reached New Bark alone, put before Elder Li on the Sprout Tower's 3F with a Magikarp at level 2. The tower is no section with a Center, and the nearest is Violet's. Li wins, the player whites out and wakes up in Violet's Pokemon Center; with the fly points the only way to a Center, the player woke up in the house in New Bark (map 63).
